content: This report reviews production efficiency at the Northfield plant during 2024. Overall equipment effectiveness improved steadily through the year, driven by reduced changeover times and better scheduling.
Production efficiency rose from 78% in Q1 to 92% in Q4. The largest quarterly gain, 8 percentage points, occurred between Q2 and Q3 after the new line balancing was introduced.

Line chart titled 'Quarterly production efficiency trend'. The x-axis shows Q1 to Q4, the y-axis shows efficiency in percent. The line rises from 78 in Q1 to 92 in Q4, with a steep increase between Q2 and Q3.
Management expects efficiency to plateau near 93% in 2025 as remaining bottlenecks are addressed. Capital spending will focus on the packaging line.
Scanned note: Shift log Q3 - line 2 stopped 14 h for gearbox replacement. Approved by plant manager.
This maintenance review summarizes unplanned downtime across all production lines in 2024. Total downtime fell as preventive maintenance coverage increased.
Unplanned downtime decreased from 120 hours in Q1 to 45 hours in Q4, a reduction of 62.5%. The main causes were bearing failures and conveyor jams.
Bar chart of downtime hours per quarter. Bars decline from 120 hours in Q1 to 45 hours in Q4. A dashed line marks the 2024 target of 60 hours, reached in Q3.
We recommend extending predictive maintenance to the conveyor system and training operators on first-line inspection to keep downtime below 40 hours per quarter.
Handwritten annotation: bearing replaced on press 3, 6 h. Signed K. Rao.
